additional_info.subject: ID0482811-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3314176150001] Check logs CRM:02889001247
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
We received the request to check the logs in the charger T3314176150001
between 12:03 and 12:09 today 7 March.
On this log we can see a car was connected with the charger and started a charge session
The car remains connected until the [Parameter Discovery] but rejected the charger for the next charging phase.
On this log report we can see the information regarding the charging session
The charger received the Identification by the MAC address but there is no PLC Link because the car was not ready, showing 0 on the red highlight.
On the next timestamp we see the car connecting at
2026-03-07T12:07:51
Failed on the Authentication
Because the car was also not ready.
We also had the same car trying to charge again but the car shown the same information not ready for the charge session.
We can see this information on the following screenshot
On the timeframe shared with us
between 12:03 and 12:09 today 7 March we don't see the car trying to charge again after check the logs.
With best regards,
eMobility Technic
al Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
